info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Update API allows for modifications to existing cheque lock box configurations based on specified parameters. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and organizations managing trade banking operations, enabling them to efficiently adjust settings associated with cheque lock boxes. By using the PATCH method, users can update specific attributes while keeping other settings intact. Typical consumers include bank administrators and developers integrating trade banking functionalities into their systems. This API ensures that businesses can adapt their trade banking services to meet changing requirements.

patch.description: Allows users to update the details of a specific cheque lock box resource identified by the resource ID. This operation is crucial for maintaining accurate and updated information regarding cheque lock boxes in the trade banking system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a cheque lock box identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are provided as per the specified schema.
